fixed_standard: All requested material facts must resolve against the frozen key, without contradictions, unsupported guesses or cross-answer borrowing. No key entries change.
same_question_evidence: A direct, unambiguous statement in the evidence attached to the same question can supply a requested fact when it itself resolves that part; an opaque section citation cannot. Do not infer a scenario result or missing quantity merely from a general rule citation. Facts from another question never count.
unasked_key_context: Explanatory key background is not automatically a requested part. Later coverage expansion explicitly tests meaningful unasked rules rather than retroactively demanding them.
support_labels: Judge content independent of supported/partial/unsupported labels. Explicit unresolved requested parts remain partial even if right facts elsewhere in that same entry are accompanied by contradictory caveats.
material_contradictions: A wrong material ruling makes an answer incorrect, even when surrounded by correct facts. Retain correct/partial/incorrect separately and flag correct claims with no snapshot support.
